# --fmt without a path formats the project's BUILD.bit, found from a
# subdirectory, and no other .bit file.
mkdir nested
cd nested
bit --fmt
! stdout .
cd ..
cmp BUILD.bit BUILD.bit.want
cmp other.bit other.bit.orig

-- BUILD.bit --
# Comment
job=exec{command='true'}
-- BUILD.bit.want --
# Comment
job = exec {
  command = 'true'
}
-- other.bit --
let x=1
-- other.bit.orig --
let x=1
